blocks.explanation:
Fraction proper hai, aur neeche ek hi linear factor teen dafa aaya hai: Case II (repeated linear factor).
Humein \((x - 1)\), \((x - 1)^2\) aur \((x - 1)^3\) teenon par fractions chahiyein.
Plan: identity, \(x = 1\) rakhna, baaqi constants coefficients compare kar ke, aur jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{2x^2 - 3x + 4}{(x - 1)^3}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Case II: \((x - 1)^3\) teen fractions deta hai, har power 1, 2, 3 ke liye ek. \(x = 1\) rakhne se sirf ek constant milta hai, is liye baaqi do coefficients compare kar ke nikalte hain.

Check karein ke fraction proper hai
Upar degree 2, neeche degree 3.
Kyun: \(2 < 3\), is liye division nahi chahiye.

Shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{2x^2 - 3x + 4}{(x - 1)^3}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{(x - 1)^2} + \dfrac{C}{(x - 1)^3}\]
Kyun: Repeated factor mein sab se oonchi power tak har power ka fraction likhna parta hai. Sirf \(\frac{C}{(x - 1)^3}\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; us se identity kabhi poori nahi hoti.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[2x^2 - 3x + 4 = A(x - 1)^2 + B(x - 1) + C \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x - 1)^3\) se multiply kiya. \(A\) ke neeche power 1 thi, to \((x - 1)^2\) bachi; \(B\) ke neeche power 2 thi, to \((x - 1)\) bacha; \(C\) ke neeche poori power 3 thi, to kuch nahi bacha.

\(C\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[2 - 3 + 4 = C\]
\[C = 3\]
Kyun: \(x - 1 = 0\), to \(A\) aur \(B\) dono terms zero.

\(A\) aur \(B\) ke liye coefficients compare karein
(i) kholein: \(Ax^2 + (B - 2A)x + (A - B + C)\).
\[x^2:\ A = 2\]
\[x:\ B - 2A = -3\]
\[B = -3 + 4 = 1\]
Kyun: Ab koi aur aisi value nahi jo do terms ek saath khatam kare, is liye identity ke coefficients milate hain. \(A(x - 1)^2 = Ax^2 - 2Ax + A\) se \(x\) ka coefficient \(-2A\) aata hai.

Constant term compare karein (tasdeeq)
\[A - B + C = 2 - 1 + 3 = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Baayen taraf ka constant 4 hai. Teesri baraabari bhi poori ho gayi, is liye teenon constants sahi hain.

Jawab likhein
\[= \dfrac{2}{x - 1} + \dfrac{1}{(x - 1)^2} + \dfrac{3}{(x - 1)^3}\]
Kyun: \(A = 2\), \(B = 1\), \(C = 3\) shakal mein rakh diye.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\[= \dfrac{2(x - 1)^2 + (x - 1) + 3}{(x - 1)^3}\]
\[= \dfrac{2x^2 - 4x + 2 + x - 1 + 3}{(x - 1)^3}\]
\[= \dfrac{2x^2 - 3x + 4}{(x - 1)^3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Common denominator \((x - 1)^3\) hai, kyunke yeh baaqi dono powers ko apne andar rakhta hai. Jor kar asal fraction wapas aa gaya.
